intuition: The area is bounded by the shorter wall. Moving the taller wall cannot improve the limiting height while it also narrows the width.

brute_force.approach: Evaluate the area for every pair of lines.

optimal.approach: Start at both ends, record the area, and move only the pointer at the shorter line.

edge_cases: At least two lines are required by the problem constraints.
Equal-height lines may move either side; moving one still explores narrower candidates.
